gng.name: Go/No-Go
gng.description: Go/No-Go task with positive (Go) or negative (No-Go) words.

tom.name: Theory of Mind
tom.description: 2AFC to indicate if a short story contains a true or false belief.

actobserv.name: Action Observation
actobserv.description: Passive viewing of videos of knots being tied, learning the name of the knot (presented at the top of the screen) for a later recall test.

affect.name: IAPS Affective
affect.description: 2AFC, indicating if a picture (scenes, animals, foods) is pleasant or unpleasant. MDTB used IAPS pictures; the MTB affective task now uses OASIS pictures.

arith.name: Arithmetic
arith.description: 2AFC, indicating if simple multiplication equations (e.g. 2x7=14) are correct or incorrect. In the control condition (digit judgement), participants view a series of four numbers and indicate the presence or absence of a target number (e.g. 1).

conditions.math: Math: judge whether the multiplication equation is correct.
conditions.digitjudgement: Digit judgement (control): indicate whether the target number is among the four numbers.

checkbrd.name: Object Viewing
checkbrd.description: Passive viewing of pictures of objects and a checkerboard pattern.

emotface.name: IAPS Emotion
emotface.description: 2AFC, indicating if a picture depicts a sad or happy face.

intrval.name: Interval Timing
intrval.description: 2AFC, indicating if a tone is short (100 ms) or long (175 ms).

mtrimgry.name: Motor Imagery
mtrimgry.description: Imagine playing a game of tennis.

fingr.name: Motor Sequence
fingr.description: 6-element sequence, either requiring one key press with each of six fingers (bimanual) or repetition of a single key press with one finger (unimanual left or right).

conditions.sequence: Finger sequence: one key press with each of six fingers.
conditions.simple: Finger simple: repeated key press with a single finger.

nbckverb.name: Verbal Working Memory
nbckverb.description: 2AFC, indicating if the current letter in a stream of letters matches the letter displayed two items previously (2-back).

nbckpic.name: Object N-Back
nbckpic.description: 2AFC, indicating if the current picture in a stream of pictures matches the picture displayed two items previously (2-back).

spatialnav.name: Spatial Imagery
spatialnav.description: Imagine walking from room to room in your childhood home, with a cue specifying the path to be taken (e.g. "Imagine walking from the kitchen to the bedroom, stopping to look around at different rooms").

stroop.name: Stroop
stroop.description: 3AFC, indicating the color of a word (3 colors), comparing conditions in which the color-word mapping is congruent or incongruent.

conditions.con: Congruent: the word names its own color.
conditions.incon: Incongruent: the word names a different color.

vrbgen.name: Verb Generation
vrbgen.description: Covert responses to visually presented nouns, either reading the noun or generating a verb associated with the noun.

conditions.generate: Verb generation: generate a verb associated with the noun.

vissearch.name: Visual Search
vissearch.description: 2AFC, indicating if a target ("L") is present among distractors ("T"), with varying set size.

rest.name: Rest
rest.description: Passive viewing of a fixation cross.

cpro.name: Concrete Permuted Rules Operations (CPRO)
cpro.description: Apply a task-rule set (logic, sensory and motor rules) to two consecutively presented stimuli (rectangles: either red or blue, vertical or horizontal).

sntncpredict.name: Word Prediction
sntncpredict.description: 2AFC, indicating if five sequentially presented words form a semantically meaningful sentence.

conditions.nviolation: Prediction: the sentence ends as predicted.
conditions.violation: Prediction violated: the last word violates the prediction.
conditions.scrambeled: Prediction scrambled: the words are in scrambled order.

sptialmap.name: Spatial Map
sptialmap.description: Memorize a spatial mapping of numbers for subsequent recall.

movie_nature.name: Nature Movie
movie_nature.description: Passive viewing of a nature clip of kickboxing kangaroos, taken from "Planet Earth II: Islands".

movie_romance.name: Animated Movie
movie_romance.description: Passive viewing of an emotional love story between two characters from the Pixar movie "Up".

movie_landscape.name: Landscape Movie
movie_landscape.description: Passive viewing of an aesthetically pleasing clip that depicts diverse scenery, taken from Vimeo.

mntalrot.name: Mental Rotation
mntalrot.description: Mentally rotate a target object to determine whether it can be brought into alignment with a baseline object. Difficulty is the angular disparity between target and baseline.

biomotion.name: Biological Motion
biomotion.description: 2AFC to identify intact point-light walkers (either happy or sad) or scrambled walkers (fast or slow).

respalt.name: Response Alternatives
respalt.description: Execute a fast motor response to an imperative signal (white cross) that appears in one of several primed positions.

pssglisten.name: Passage Listening
pssglisten.description: Participants listen to speech passages. No response is required.

conditions.degraded: Degraded: the speech is acoustically degraded (muffled) and cannot be understood.

motor_tongue.name: Tongue Movement
motor_tongue.description: Participants move their tongue right to left against the upper premolar teeth, paced by a flashing circle around a fixation cross.

audnarrative.name: Auditory Narrative
audnarrative.description: Participants listen to 30-second audio snippets from a story (The Moth Radio Hour), presented in order across runs so they follow the narrative.

oddball.name: Oddball
oddball.description: Participants see a black or red 'K' or 'O' on screen and press a button only when a red 'K' appears.

dmndgrid.name: Demand Grid
dmndgrid.description: Participants see a sequence of steps that each light up boxes in a grid (here 12 boxes, 3 steps, 2 boxes per step), mentally combine them into a single pattern, then choose which of two grids matches the full sequence.

read.name: Reading
read.description: Participants silently read sentences or nonword sequences, presented one word at a time.
